comparisons.peer_summary: First-Line Units (FLUs) and control functions are responsible for managing all aspects of their businesses, including compliance and operational risk. They must understand their processes and risks, monitor controls, conduct quality assurance, adhere to risk appetite limits, and proactively identify and escalate risks to strengthen organizational resiliency.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Bank of America address operational resiliency, though from different angles: Citi focuses on technical system restoration improvements, while BAC focuses on governance and responsibility. Citi reports simplifying system restoration to reduce downtime for critical applications. BAC states that First-Line Units and control functions are responsible for monitoring controls and identifying risks to strengthen compliance and operational resiliency, defined as the ability to deliver critical operations through disruption. Both disclosures link operational actions to the broader goal of maintaining the ability to deliver critical services despite disruptions.

sentences.text: • Improved resiliency and reduced downtime by simplifying system restoration to a single click for approximately 26% of critical applications

FLUs and control functions are required to understand their business processes and related risks and controls, including third-party dependencies and the related regulatory requirements, and monitor and report on the effectiveness of the control environment.
Collectively, these efforts are important to strengthen their compliance and operational resiliency, which is the ability to deliver critical operations through disruption.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company maintains a comprehensive business continuity program and resilience framework to ensure critical functions can continue operating during disruptions, supported by regular testing of response and recovery strategies.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Goldman Sachs focus on the structural framework for business resilience and system restoration. Citi discloses specific operational improvements where it simplified system restoration to a single click for 26% of critical applications to reduce downtime. Similarly, Goldman Sachs describes maintaining a comprehensive business continuity program and resilience framework specifically designed to ensure that critical functions can continue to operate during disruptions. While Citi reports on a specific technical execution milestone (single-click restoration), GS details the governance framework (BCP and crisis management principles) that enables such recovery capabilities.

sentences.text: • Improved resiliency and reduced downtime by simplifying system restoration to a single click for approximately 26% of critical applications
Our resilience framework defines the fundamental principles for BCP and crisis management to ensure that critical functions can continue to operate in the event of a disruption.
We seek to maintain a business continuity program that is comprehensive, consistent on a firmwide basis, and up-to-date, incorporating new information, including resilience capabilities.

comparisons.peer_summary: The Technology Resiliency function establishes control requirements for planning and testing the prioritized recovery of technology services during outages, supporting the Firmwide Business Resiliency Program.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and JPMorgan disclose specific initiatives related to technology resiliency and service recovery. Citi highlights the simplification of system restoration for critical applications to reduce downtime. JPMorgan describes its Technology Resiliency function, which establishes control requirements for planning and testing the prioritized recovery of technology services during degradation or outages. Both disclosures center on the operational mechanics of restoring technology services to ensure continuity, with Citi reporting on progress in restoration speed and JPMorgan reporting on the control environment for prioritized recovery.

Technology Resiliency, which establishes control requirements for planning and testing the prioritized recovery of technology services in the event of degradation or outage, including incident response planning, data backup and retention, and recovery readiness in support of the Firmwide Business Resiliency Program and operational risk management practices.

comparisons.peer_topic: Operational Resilience Program Components and Testing
comparisons.peer_summary: The Firm maintains a Firmwide resilience program designed to ensure operational resilience and recovery of critical processes, comprising business continuity management, technology disaster recovery, third party resilience, and key business service resilience, with validation performed through internal and third-party testing.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Morgan Stanley describe resilience programs focused on critical processes and technology recovery. Citi's disclosure notes improvements in resiliency by simplifying system restoration for critical applications. Morgan Stanley outlines a Firmwide resilience program that includes technology disaster recovery and key business service resilience as core elements, validated through testing. While Citi reports on a specific reduction in restoration effort (single-click for 26% of apps), MS describes the broader programmatic components (business continuity, tech disaster recovery) that encompass such technical recovery capabilities.

sentences.text: • Improved resiliency and reduced downtime by simplifying system restoration to a single click for approximately 26% of critical applications

The Firm maintains a Firmwide resilience program that is designed to provide for operational resilience and enable it to respond to and recover critical processes and supporting assets in the event of a disruption impacting our people, technology, facilities and third parties.
The key elements of the Firm's resilience program include business continuity management, technology disaster recovery, third party resilience and key business service resilience.
